Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
SNOW STAKES FOR MOUNTAINEERING 



1. Scope — Lays down the requirements for three types of snow stakes for mountaineering. 

2. Dimensions

IS: 8908 -1978 

2.3 Snow Stake, Type C 

35 




All dimensions in millimetres. 

3. Material — Snow stakes of Types A and B shall be manufactured from aluminium alloy conforming 
to designation HE19 of IS : 733-1967 ' Specification for wrought aluminium and aluminium alloys, bars, 
rods and sections (for general engineering purposes) {first revision)'. Snow stakes of Type C 
shall be manufactured from aluminium alloy conforming to designation HT19 of IS : 738-1966 
' Specification for wrought aluminium alloys, drawn tubes for general engineering purposes'. 

4. Workmanship and Finish — Snow stakes shall be free from cracks and other defects. All holes 
shall be chamfered on both sides. 

4.1 Snow stakes shall be given anodic coating to Grade AC15 of IS : 1868-1968 ' Specification for 
anodic coating on aluminium '. 

5. Designation — Snow stakes shall be designated by name, type and size (in case of Type 
A only ). A snow stake of Type A and nominal size 500 mm shall be designated: 

Snow Stake A 500, IS : 8903 

6. Marking — Snow stakes shall be marked with manufacturer's name and trade-mark. 
6.1 ISJ Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPL ANATORY NOTE 

This standard covers snow stakes used as snow anchor in mountaineering. Although no mass 
has been laid down, every effort should be made to manufacture the snow stakes having a mass as 
minimum as possible while maintaining the strength.
